paths.name: scout_v4:FC up onto its posts
paths.why: the FC on its grommets up from below onto its 4 posts (M3 into the inserts) with the receiver off (the battery mechanism bolts on after: its room is the boards' way in), the screws' heads from below

paths.name: scout_v4:XR2 up onto its land
paths.why: the XR2 taped up from below onto its land beside the FC with the receiver off (the battery mechanism bolts on after: its room is the boards' way in)

paths.name: scout_v4:DRV8833 up onto its land
paths.why: the DRV8833 taped up from below onto its land beside the FC with the receiver off (the battery mechanism bolts on after: its room is the boards' way in)

paths.name: scout_v4:Radxa up onto its posts
paths.why: the Radxa up from below onto its 4 posts (M2.5 into the inserts) with the receiver off (the battery mechanism bolts on after: its room is the boards' way in), the screws' heads from below; its tail third through the tail tray's window, before the UBEC (which hangs under it)

paths.name: scout_v4:UBEC up into its pod
paths.why: the UBEC taped up under its two end lands in the pod below the tail tray, after the Radxa (it closes the Radxa's way in)

paths.name: scout_v4:flow sensor up into its pod
paths.why: the MTF-02P taped up under its land in the nose pod, open below

paths.name: scout_v4:pinion up into its bay
paths.why: the 12 T pinion (O11.42, its O7 hub boss toward the tip bearing) up from below into its bay, open downward 11.92 wide, the receiver off; it waits there, its hub on the tip bearing's boss, for the N20's shaft

paths.name: scout_v4:N20 up behind its seat and forward
paths.why: the N20's gearbox and can (their 12 x 10 x 27 box) up from below 10.5 behind the seat, then forward: the gearbox pressed between the two rails 12.3 apart (the fit table's press, a hand push) onto the face plate; no screws (24 Nov, the bench: the 2 x M1.6 had no driver line and their heads stood in the pinion): the rails take its torque, the plate and the pressed pinion hold it along y; out the same way with every board in place (the DRV8833 3 forward of its drop)

paths.name: scout_v4:N20's shaft down behind its seat
paths.why: the N20's 3 mm shaft, drawn where it is with the motor 10.5 behind its seat, down with it through the pocket's front

paths.name: scout_v4:N20's shaft into the tip bearing
paths.why: the N20's 3 mm D shaft forward through the face plate's hole, pressed through the pinion's D bore (the pinion against the tip bearing's boss) and into the tip bearing's 3.2 bore (the fit table's close fit: its seat)

paths.name: scout_v4:roller in from behind
paths.why: the pressure roller (rod, two tubes, saddle and leaf) in through the spool's bay from behind, before the spool, then out along its radial guides and into the leaf's pocket (the rod in its 3.3 slots: the fit table's free fit)

paths.name: scout_v4:spool in from behind
paths.why: the spool with its gear, drum hub, cable coil and the blades' ends in from behind (-x) between the two axle bosses, level under RM-RB's collar, then down 0.85 over its last 7 mm onto the pinion and against the roller (the gear mesh and the roller's leaf are its seats)
